topic: Do carrots give perfect eyesight? Myth vs fact

youtube.title: Do carrots give perfect eyesight? 🥕 Myth vs fact #Shorts
youtube.description:
Eat carrots and you'll never need glasses. Myth or fact?
கேரட் சாப்பிட்டால் கண்ணாடி தேவையில்லையா? உண்மை என்ன?

• Myth: carrots cannot fix short sight, long sight or astigmatism; those come from the shape of the eye
• Carrots contain beta-carotene, which the body turns into vitamin A; the retina needs it to see in dim light
• The carrot story spread in World War II, partly to hide that British pilots used radar
• Eat a rainbow: leafy greens (keerai), eggs, fish, colourful fruits and vegetables
• Wear good sunglasses in strong sun, don't smoke, and keep sugar and BP in control
• Seeing at night suddenly harder? See an eye specialist

gmb.text: Do carrots give you perfect eyesight? It is a myth. Carrots cannot fix short sight, long sight or astigmatism, because those come from the shape of the eye. Carrots do help in another way: they contain beta-carotene, which the body turns into vitamin A, and the retina needs vitamin A to see in dim light. Fun fact: the carrot story spread during World War II, partly to hide that British pilots were using radar. For healthy eyes, eat a rainbow of foods such as leafy greens, eggs, fish and colourful fruits and vegetables, stay active, don't smoke, wear good sunglasses in strong sun, and keep sugar and blood pressure under control. If you need glasses, no food can replace them. Book an eye test on WhatsApp: 044 4356 9998
